I pulled the CSV and sketched an initial owner lattice (high-level mapping of Redwood AEs/CSMs -> Contoso sellers -> Microsoft field). See notes below and the ask list at the end. Attaching our working file (owner_lattice_v1.xlsx).

High-level approach:
- We group accounts into 3 swimlanes (strategic, mid-market, scoped pilots) and assign a Redwood owner for outreach + a named Contoso seller for co-sell.
- For accounts flagged as strategic we recommend dual outreach (Redwood AE + Solutions Engineer) to establish pilot success criteria.
- For marketplace billing accounts we’ll confirm tenant IDs before intake.

Immediate asks for Contoso:
1) Confirm the Contoso seller names and emails for the 12 accounts marked as "TBD" in the spreadsheet.
2) Approve contact for co-sell consent (person who can sign DocuSign).
3) Confirm whether any accounts are on reseller-only billing (that affects PC intake).

Next steps I propose:
- Vanessa and Karthik will review the lattice and propose final owner switchover logic.
- Once agreed we’ll create the Partner Center referral package and request co-sell consent via DocuSign.

Attachments: owner_lattice_v1.xlsx (Redwood working mapping)

Maria / team — thanks for moving quickly on this. To make the Partner Center referral smooth, here’s the intake checklist we’ll use and the ask cadence:

Partner Center intake checklist (minimum):
- Confirm account list + tenant IDs (CSV)
- Confirm Contoso seller contact for each account (name + email + MPN ID if available)
- Signed co-sell consent (DocuSign) from an authorized Contoso approver
- Customer contact for technical onboarding (SE or IT admin)

Operational flow:
1) Contoso confirms missing seller contacts and tenant IDs (Maria) — target by 9/10.
2) Redwood sends DocuSign powerform for co-sell consent to Contoso approver (I’ll kick this off once we have confirmed list).
3) Microsoft PC support validates eligibility and issues referral ticket number.

Maria — I started the DocuSign flow for the 7 pilot accounts (link below). Please route to your approver for signature. I’ve also looped in pc-support@microsoft.com to confirm eligibility once signed.

DocuSign powerform: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=ABCDE
